mentions.name: KaithemAutomation
mentions.description: An automation server (KaithemAutomation) being refactored so its device driver plugins use JSON schemas for configuration instead of the old flat, strings-only key-value format with a set_config_properties UI-hint function, with auto-upgrade shims to keep old configs working.
mentions.problem: The old flat key-value config format for device driver plugins felt un-best-practicesful and needed replacement.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Disenhackifying one of the last pieces of my KaithemAutomation server that still feels not best practicesful.

Device driver plugins used to have a very simple flat key value, strings only format, with a set_config_properties function to tell the host what kind of UI to show.

That's all getting replaced with JSON schemas, with some auto-upgrade shims so old config keeps working.
